## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, …); it decides the next version.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, tests).
- [ ] New behavior has a test.
- [ ] README updated for any change to props, exports, the guide format or the skill.
- [ ] No page-specific or customer-specific names, data, hostnames or secrets.
